title: artokun/comfyui-mcp

description: Self-hosted AI agent for Garmin Connect. Analyze health & training data, build workouts, use Telegram or local LLMs.

title: Mesh-LLM/mesh-llm
description: Distributed AI/LLM for the people. Share compute privately or publicly to power your agents and chat.

title: artokun/comfyui-mcp-panel
description: The local-first sidebar AI agent for ComfyUI — runs on your own Claude OR ChatGPT subscription (no API keys, no extra LLM costs). Drives your live graph: edits, workflows & installs in natural language. The panel UI for comfyui-mcp, the agent-native control plane for ComfyUI.

title: Spitfire-Products/nexus-cortex
description: A headless, multi-provider AI agent harness — embed it as a library, script it from the CLI, or run it as a stateful agent server. One orchestrator drives every major LLM provider.

title: adecubed/gigamail
description: Mail for AI agents ( and humans). MCP server giving Claude (or any agent) safe, permission-controlled access to email (Microsoft Graph + IMAP), calendar and your knowledge files. title: cvsz/zworkforce

title: bgill55/daedalus
description: Daedalus is a standalone terminal-based AI coding assistant that runs on your machine. title: choreographr/choreographr
description: Choreographr is an all purpose extensible AI agent system written entirely in Rust. It has a client/server architecture and can run many sessions simulataneously. title: agentd-dev/source-code
description: A minimal, MCP-native, cloud-native AI agent runtime. One small static Rust binary runs one agent: hand it an instruction and one LLM endpoint, and it runs the agentic loop — think, call a tool, observe, repeat — until the task reaches a terminal status or a new event wakes it.

title: 99percentgrip/agent-vesper
description: Agent Vesper is a pure-Rust AI agent harness that remembers you across conversations. It provides a provider-neutral runtime where any LLM provider can plug in — today it ships with the Z.ai GLM adapter, tomorrow any provider can join with zero TUI or runtime changes.

title: hycccc/soundlabel

title: Hiroto-Kobayashi-30/local-Vibe
description: Run an AI coding agent locally with Ollama and open-source LLMs — no cloud API or internet required.

title: JoshithReddyAleti/GenAI_Engineer_roadmap
description: The complete GenAI Engineering Roadmap 2026 — one index for the whole series. Start at Episode 1, or jump to any layer. Bridges into the Agentic AI Roadmap 2027.

title: goruck/home-generative-agent
description: AI agent for Home Assistant — talk to your home, create automations in plain language, analyze cameras with face recognition, and get proactive anomaly alerts. Cloud LLMs or fully local via Ollama.

title: AgentParadise/agentic-primitives
description: Composable building blocks for AI coding agents. Model-agnostic prompts and tools that work with Claude, GPT, or any LLM provider.

title: marcoakes/wringer
description: One command that proves whether a change is mergeable, and leaves behind evidence a human or an agent can inspect. Runs your repo's own gates; no LLM, no cloud, nothing uploaded. The verification core of a vendor-neutral AI-DLC harness.
